## What's new in 0.4.0

**Hand off a session between Claude Code and Codex.** The new side-by-side transfer view copies the transferable conversation into the other tool's native history, then offers its resume command. The original session stays in place. Claude Code → Codex uses Codex's own importer; Codex → Claude Code creates a new Claude session. Unsupported attachments stop the transfer instead of silently dropping content. Hidden internal reasoning is not copied.

**WorkBuddy sessions.** Orrery now reads WorkBuddy's local session records, including its own generated title, project, model, status, disk size, and token usage. Calls split across multiple items are counted once by message ID. WorkBuddy is read-only in Orrery; delete and resume are not offered.

**Smaller changes.** Session details can copy the session ID. The README now opens with a three-language app demo, and the frontend and cleanup code have been split into smaller modules.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `Orrery_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Orrery_0.4.0_x64_en-US.msi` |
| macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Orrery_0.4.0_universal.dmg` |
| Linux x64 | `Orrery_0.4.0_amd64.AppImage` (portable), `Orrery_0.4.0_amd64.deb` or `Orrery-0.4.0-1.x86_64.rpm` |

The builds are not code-signed. macOS and Linux packages are built and checked in CI, but have not been run on those desktops by the author. See the [README](https://github.com/arvelvale/orrery#readme) for installation notes and current limitations.
